response.sql:
SELECT invoice_number,
       AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio,
       COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A line item with derived_product_cost equal to zero has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the average; line items with NULL costs are likewise ignored by AVG. Ties in line item count are ordered by invoice number.
